name: aiops-paper128-lora-v2
protocol: Fresh adapter from Qwen3-8B, never resume adapters trained on the old 214-event AIOps cohort.
Train only on the 102 frozen training incidents; final checkpoint after exactly 3 epochs, no test-based model selection.
Each incident supplies one supervised training example; 26 test incidents supply inputs only.
Prompt contains all 10 services, own-baseline metric/log/trace contrasts, RPC residuals, current calls and training-only historical facts.
No base/evidence-model predictions, root/fault labels, injection targets or real incident IDs appear in inputs.
Candidate service-to-letter mapping is permuted deterministically without labels; primary order seed 42, two additional orders are prespecified robustness checks.
Supervised target is a single candidate letter, not a fabricated causal explanation. Inference ranks the same 10 single-token letter logits with and without LoRA.
Primary comparison is independent LoRA vs identical unadapted Qwen prompt and primary base seed 42. Fixed base/LoRA and evidence/LoRA fusions are secondary controls.
All results remain exploratory because the fixed test cohort has already been inspected. No test-driven prompt, hyperparameter or checkpoint revision in this run.
